goal: 澄清误会并修复与室友的关系

n1.speaker: 室友 Emily
n1.line: It was you who borrowed my laptop last night, and now my files are gone. I demand an explanation.
n1.lineCn: 昨晚是你借走了我的笔记本电脑,现在我的文件不见了。我需要一个解释。

grammar.name: It was...who 强调句
grammar.note: It was you who... 用 it is/was+被强调部分+who/that 强调主语 you,语气强烈。

options.text: It was not me who touched your laptop. I was in the library until eleven.
options.textCn: 碰你电脑的人不是我。我在图书馆待到十一点。
options.feedback: 冷静否认并提供不在场证明。

options.text: I did borrow it, but it was only to check my email for five minutes.
options.textCn: 我确实借了,但只是查了五分钟邮件。

options.text: I did not touch your laptop, and I am offended that you accuse me without proof.
options.textCn: 我没碰你的电脑,你无凭无据指责我,我很生气。

n2.speaker: 室友 Emily
n2.line: Then who was it? It was only after I checked the usage history that I found someone logged in at nine.
n2.lineCn: 那是谁?我查了使用记录才发现,九点有人登录。

grammar.name: It was only after...that 强调句
grammar.note: 强调时间状语 only after I checked the usage history,突出"直到检查记录才…"。

options.text: It was our roommate Tom who needed your laptop for his presentation, and he asked me to tell you.
options.textCn: 是室友 Tom 需要你的电脑做展示,他让我转告你。
options.feedback: 说出真相,嫌疑开始澄清。

options.text: It was not until you just said that that I realised someone else has your password.
options.textCn: 直到你刚才说,我才意识到有人知道你的密码。

options.text: I do not know, and it is not my business to find out.
options.textCn: 我不知道,查明真相也不是我的事。

n3.speaker: 室友 Emily
n3.line: You admit it! What I care about is not the time you used it but the missing files.
n3.lineCn: 你承认了!我在意的不是你用了多久,而是丢失的文件。

grammar.name: What 引导主语从句的强调
grammar.note: What I care about is... 用 what 从句作主语,起到类似强调句的突出作用。

options.text: You are right to be upset, but it was Tom who deleted the files, not me.
options.textCn: 你生气是对的,但删文件的是 Tom,不是我。

options.text: It was not I who caused the problem. Your antivirus software is outdated.
options.textCn: 造成问题的人不是我。你的杀毒软件过时了。
options.feedback: 推卸责任还怪软件,Emily 反感。

options.text: I will not argue with you. Whatever happened, I apologise for my part.
options.textCn: 我不和你争。无论发生了什么,我为我的部分道歉。

n4.speaker: 室友 Emily
n4.line: Anger will not solve anything. It is the truth that I want, not excuses.
n4.lineCn: 生气解决不了问题。我要的是真相,不是借口。

grammar.name: It is...that 强调句
grammar.note: It is the truth that I want 强调宾语 the truth,与 not excuses 对比,语气明确。

options.text: Then let me tell you the truth calmly: I saw Tom using your laptop at nine o'clock.
options.textCn: 那我平静地告诉你真相:九点我看见 Tom 在用你的电脑。
options.feedback: 提供目击信息,嫌疑转移。

options.text: The truth is that I was in the library, and several classmates can confirm it.
options.textCn: 真相是我在图书馆,好几个同学可以作证。

options.text: I have already said what I know. It is you who refuses to listen.
options.textCn: 我已经说了我知道的。不肯听的人是你。

n5.speaker: 室友 Emily
n5.line: Oh, Tom? It was Tom who had my account? I wish you had told me earlier.
n5.lineCn: 哦,是 Tom?用我账号的是 Tom?真希望你早告诉我。

grammar.name: It was...who+虚拟语气
grammar.note: It was Tom who had my account 强调施动者,后接 wish 从句表遗憾,语义层层递进。

options.text: I did plan to tell you, but it was only after you accused me that I found the chance.
options.textCn: 我本想告诉你,但你指责我之后我才找到机会。
options.feedback: 解释合情合理,误会消解。

options.text: Now you see it was never my fault. What I want is a proper apology from you.
options.textCn: 现在你看到了吧,根本不是我的错。我要的是你正式道歉。

options.text: Yes, and he said he would explain everything to you himself.
options.textCn: 是的,他说他会亲自向你解释一切。
options.feedback: 给出后续安排,信任恢复。

n5b.speaker: 室友 Emily
n5b.line: Tom just confessed that it was he who used my account. I owe you a sincere apology.
n5b.lineCn: Tom 刚才承认用我账号的是他。我该向你真诚道歉。

grammar.name: It was he who 强调句(道歉)
grammar.note: that it was he who used my account 中强调 he,以澄清责任归属,用于正式道歉。

options.text: It is I who should apologise too, for not telling you earlier.
options.textCn: 我也该道歉,没早点告诉你。

options.text: I told you so. What I want now is for everyone to admit they were wrong.
options.textCn: 我早说了吧。我现在要的是每个人都承认错误。

options.text: Apology accepted. It was a misunderstanding from the very beginning.
options.textCn: 接受道歉。这从一开始就是一场误会。
options.feedback: 大度释怀,误会基本消除。

n6.speaker: 室友 Emily
n6.line: Refusing to cooperate only deepens my suspicion. It is precisely this attitude that makes me doubt you.
n6.lineCn: 拒绝配合只会加深我的怀疑。正是这种态度让我怀疑你。

grammar.name: It is...that 强调句(态度)
grammar.note: It is precisely this attitude that... 用 precisely 加强语气,强调是态度而非其他。

options.text: I am sorry. It was wrong of me to remain silent. Let me help you investigate.
options.textCn: 对不起。保持沉默是我的错。让我帮你查清楚。

options.text: I do not care what you think. It was your carelessness that left the laptop unlocked.
options.textCn: 我不在乎你怎么想。是你不锁电脑的粗心害的。

options.text: Fine, I will cooperate. It is the least I can do to clear my name.
options.textCn: 行,我配合。这是洗清我名声最起码能做的。

n7.speaker: 室友 Emily
n7.line: Blaming others is a poor excuse. It is responsibility that builds trust between friends.
n7.lineCn: 指责别人是拙劣的借口。是责任感建立起朋友间的信任。

grammar.name: It is...that 强调句(责任)
grammar.note: It is responsibility that builds trust 强调 responsibility,说明关键要素。

options.text: You are right. It was I who should have reminded Tom to ask you first.
options.textCn: 你说得对。我本该提醒 Tom 先征求你同意。

options.text: I take no blame whatsoever. It is the thief who deserves your anger, not me.
options.textCn: 我没有任何责任。该挨骂的是小偷,不是我。

options.text: I accept my share of responsibility, and I will tell Tom myself.
options.textCn: 我接受我那份责任,而且我会亲自去告诉 Tom。

n8.speaker: 室友 Emily
n8.line: Thank you for being honest. It is only after talking things through that I realise how quick I was to judge.
n8.lineCn: 谢谢你的坦诚。直到把事情谈开,我才意识到自己多轻易就下了判断。

grammar.name: It is only after...that 强调句
grammar.note: 强调时间状语 only after talking things through,表达"直到谈开才醒悟"的转折。

options.text: We both overreacted. It was the misunderstanding that caused the trouble, not us.
options.textCn: 我们都反应过度了。造成麻烦的是误会,不是我们。

options.text: I am glad you see it now. What matters is that our friendship survives this.
options.textCn: 很高兴你现在明白了。重要的是我们的友谊经得起这次波折。

options.text: I forgive you, but it was humiliating to be accused in front of the whole dorm.
options.textCn: 我原谅你,但在全宿舍面前被指责很丢人。

n8b.speaker: 室友 Emily
n8b.line: The files are still in the recycle bin. It was only a matter of minutes before they vanished for good.
n8b.lineCn: 文件还在回收站里。再差几分钟,它们就永远消失了。

grammar.name: It was only... 强调
grammar.note: It was only a matter of minutes 用 only 限定,强调时间的紧迫与侥幸。

options.text: Then let us restore them immediately. It is speed that matters now.
options.textCn: 那我们立刻恢复。现在重要的是速度。

options.text: It is lucky that Tom is a careful user. Nothing is truly lost.
options.textCn: 幸好 Tom 用电脑很小心,什么都没真正丢失。

options.text: I will leave the restoring to you. It was your laptop, after all.
options.textCn: 恢复文件的事就交给你吧。毕竟那是你的电脑。

n8c.speaker: 室友 Emily
n8c.line: Restored! See, it was not a disaster at all. It was our quick reaction that saved the day.
n8c.lineCn: 恢复好了!看吧,根本不是灾难。是我们的快速反应拯救了局面。

grammar.name: It was...that 强调句(反应)
grammar.note: It was our quick reaction that saved the day 强调 our quick reaction,肯定双方努力。

options.text: True. It was our teamwork that solved this in an hour.
options.textCn: 没错。是我们的团队合作在一小时内解决了问题。

options.text: I wish we had reacted this quickly at the very beginning.
options.textCn: 真希望一开始我们就能反应这么快。

options.text: The day is saved, but it was my reputation that was nearly ruined.
options.textCn: 今天得救了,但差点被毁的是我的名声。

n9.speaker: 室友 Emily
n9.line: Let us recover the rest together. It is together that we can solve this fastest.
n9.lineCn: 剩下的我们一起解决。正是合作,我们才能最快解决。

grammar.name: It is together that 强调句
grammar.note: It is together that... 强调方式状语 together,突出合作的重要性。

options.text: Yes, let us start tonight. It was never about the laptop but about trust.
options.textCn: 好,今晚就开始。这从来不是电脑的问题,而是信任的问题。
options.feedback: 点明本质,关系彻底修复。

options.text: I will help, but it is Tom who should do the heavy lifting.
options.textCn: 我会帮忙,但出大力的应该是 Tom。

options.text: Agreed. It is a relief that the misunderstanding is finally cleared.
options.textCn: 同意。误会终于澄清,真是松了一口气。

success.speaker: 室友 Emily
success.line: You are a true friend. It is moments like this that strengthen a bond.
success.lineCn: 你是个真正的朋友。正是这样的时刻让情谊更加牢固。

fail1.speaker: 室友 Emily
fail1.line: I see your true attitude now. It is hard to trust someone who shifts all the blame.
fail1.lineCn: 我现在看清你的态度了。很难信任一个把责任全推掉的人。

fail2.speaker: 室友 Emily
fail2.line: Our friendship will recover only when you learn to own your share. It is sincerity that heals.
fail2.lineCn: 只有当你学会承担自己那份责任,我们的友谊才能修复。是真诚治愈一切。
